description: Block lifetime at the semantic stage for the two control forms the existing `undefined-var-block-local-dies-at-the-bracket` does not cover (spec/execution-model.md:367-369,603-605). Both reads are reported in ONE program, which a runtime fixture cannot do — execution stops at the first error — so this is the only place the `if` and `while` claims are asserted together. `:n` is written inside the `while` body and read after it with no diagnostic, which is the negative that keeps the rule from being read as "a block hides everything".
